headline: The failures in US critical infrastructure that Mexico cannot ignore
summary: A configuration change on Microsoft servers on November 12 left users in more than 70 countries without email and Teams for almost a day and a half. Bloomberg reported that financial operators had to use phones.
why: Microsoft is a US technology company whose cloud and productivity software are widely used by banks and businesses. Outages at such providers raise operational risk concerns across the financial sector.
original_headline: Las fallas en la infraestructura crítica de EUA que México no puede ignorar
